international.title: Russian ship hit in Benghazi by suspected Ukrainian drone attack, say Libyan officials
international.summary: No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia A suspected Ukrainian drone attack caused an explosion on a Russian warship docked at the naval base in the Libyan port city of Benghazi, Libyan officials have said. The strike severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy warship, and ignited a fire at the naval base, they said. Several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya, according to an initial investigation into the attack. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, the officials told the Associated Press. Continue reading...
